name: Christmas Standing Prime Rib Roast (Center Eye) & Yorkshire Pudding / Popovers
whyItWorks: Slow-roasted medium-rare prime rib is melt-in-your-mouth tender with zero plant fiber, and egg-rich Yorkshire puddings puff into airy refined-flour popovers.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trim away the outer fat cap and peppercorn crust, eat the lean center "eye" of the ribeye dipped in clear au jus, and skip the spicy creamy horseradish sauce.
watchOuts: Trim the heavy ribeye fat cap and black peppercorn crust
